title: API error v1
description: Safe server error envelope. HTTP/code pairs: 400 INVALID_REQUEST; 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; 404 CASE_NOT_FOUND, PROGRAM_NOT_FOUND, ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND, FORM_NOT_AVAILABLE (answer endpoint) or NOT_FOUND; 409 CASE_ID_UNAVAILABLE, CASE_REVISION_MISMATCH, PACKET_GENERATION_CONFLICT, FORM_CONTEXT_MISMATCH, FORM_ANSWERS_CONFLICT, FORM_ANSWERS_STALE, FORM_ANSWER_REVISION_MISMATCH, FORM_NOT_AVAILABLE (export endpoint), EVIDENCE_CONFLICT, EXPORT_GENERATION_CONFLICT, REQUEST_REVISION_MISMATCH, REQUEST_UPDATE_CONFLICT or REQUEST_HISTORY_FULL; 410 EXPORT_EXPIRED; 422 INVALID_IMAGE or EXPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 429 RATE_LIMITED, UPLOAD_BUSY or EXPORT_BUSY; 507 STORAGE_LIMIT_REACHED (including draft-checklist preparation); 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; 415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE; 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED; 500 INTERNAL_ERROR; 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Clients display local safe messages, never raw server details.
